questions.q:
A series is given with one term missing. Select the correct alternative from the given ones that will complete the series.

-513, -506, ? , -492, -485, -478, -471, -464
questions.solution:
Every term increases by 7. The missing term after −506 is −499.

**Answer: -499**

questions.q:
A series is given with one term missing. Select the correct alternative from the given ones that will complete the series.

 ? , 50, 148, 294, 880, 1758, 5272, 10542
questions.solution:
Alternate multiplying by 2 and 3, then subtract 2 each time. The missing first term satisfies 2x−2=50, giving x=26.

**Answer: 26**

questions.q:
A series is given with one term missing. Select the correct alternative from the given ones that will complete the series.

 O, V, C, J, Q, ?, E, L
questions.solution:
Each letter moves forward 7 positions, wrapping after Z. Q moves to X, then E and L.

**Answer: X**

questions.q:
A series is given with one term missing. Select the correct alternative from the given ones that will complete the series.

T, ?, Z, C, F, I, L, O
questions.solution:
Each letter advances 3 places. T is followed by W, then Z,C,F,I,L,O.

**Answer: W**

questions.q: If the month of November 2026 started on Friday, then which date will be the first Saturday of May 2027?
questions.solution:
Under the hypothetical Friday start, 181 days to 1 May move the weekday six places, making May 1 Thursday. The first Saturday is May 3.

**Answer: 3**

questions.q: A person was born on 21 September 2018. What day of the week will be on his 11th birthday?
questions.solution:
The eleventh birthday is 21 September 2029. Calendar calculation gives Friday.

**Answer: Friday**

questions.q: 5 girls A, B, C, D and E are sitting in a row facing north (not necessarily in the same order). Only E is to the left of D. Only C is to the right of A. Who is in the middle of the row?
questions.solution:
Only E left of D fixes E,D in the first two seats. Only C right of A fixes A,C in the last two. B occupies the middle.

**Answer: B**

questions.q: 5 persons A, B, C, D and E are sitting in a row facing north (not necessarily in the same order). C is at third position from right end of the row. A is fourth to the left of E. D is to the right of B. What is the position of D from the left end of the row?
questions.solution:
A must occupy position 1 and E position 5. C is in position 3. D right of B gives B at 2 and D at 4.

**Answer: Fourth**

questions.q: 7 boys A, B, C, D, X, Y and Z are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order). B is not the immediate neighbour of X. C is fifth to the left of D. C is the immediate neighbour of B and Y. A is the immediate neighbour of Z and D. Who is sitting fourth to the left of B?
questions.solution:
Applying the circular neighbour and offset conditions places X fourth to the left of B. The valid arrangement is checked by enumerating all seatings.

**Answer: X**

 AD120 : ? :: BK220 : DN720 :: DL170 : FO670

questions.q:
Select the option that is related to the fourth number in the same way as the first number is related to the second number and fifth number is related to sixth number.

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g.13 – Operations on 13 such as adding /subtracting /multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed)

 276 : 506 :: ? : 483 :: 145 : 375
questions.solution:
The second number exceeds the first by 230. Thus the missing first number is 483−230=253.

**Answer: 253**

questions.q:
Select the option that is related to the fifth number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number and fourth number is related to third number.

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g.13 – Operations on 13 such as adding /subtracting /multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed)

 9 : 1331 :: 13 : 3375 :: 19 : ?
questions.solution:
Add 2 to the first number and cube: 11³=1331 and 15³=3375. For 19, obtain 21³=9261.

**Answer: 9261**

questions.q: In a certain code language, 'human react space' is coded as 'pa ps tq' and 'space has possibilities' is coded as 'tq tm pm'. How will 'space' be coded in that code language?
questions.solution:
Space is the only shared word and tq is the only shared code. Therefore space is tq.

**Answer: tq**

questions.q: In a certain code language, 'RAGE' is coded as ' 76 ' and 'POINT' is coded as ' 60 '. How will 'TAIL' be coded in that code language?
questions.solution:
Sum reverse-alphabet positions, then subtract 1. For TAIL: 7+26+18+15−1=65. This also gives 76 for RAGE and 60 for POINT.

**Answer: 65**
